We need to produce correct XML tags. Let's construct the call.

<thought>We need to find template ID for nitro reduction. Use the amine SMILES as target molecule and search for templates that break amine to nitro (reverse). We'll call search_template_catalog_by_criteria.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "NC1=CC(N2CCN(C(OC(C)(C)C)=O)CC2)=C3C(CCC4(CCC4)O3)=C1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["amine"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["nitro"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
